race.comment: THE IRON STAR (8) can bounce back after two runs where he simply gave away too much start, and with a stronger tempo and a closer spot he's dangerous. PROXIMA DEA (10) has opened her career with two sharp wins and Nock should press forward under the light weight and make her hard to catch again. FEDERAL RESERVE (1) only warmed late first-up then put them away second-up with the blinkers on. With Berry aboard he stays in the fight. DORADUS (3) controlled things at Canterbury and won well, but this will not be the same picnic. Lloyd sticking is an obvious boost. CHANNELLING (13) has been hitting the line with purpose and can settle closer for King. With no weight she can get involved.
